name: DOMPERIDONE 10 MG 30 PRAZY TABLETS
description: Domperidone 10 mg (Prazy) is a medicine used to relieve nausea and vomiting in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and over, weighing at least 35 kg. It belongs to a group of medicines called prokinetics, which help increase contractions of the stomach and intestines. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
